speaker: Patient
text: 71-year-old male. The patient complains of fatigue and malaise over the last few months. He also reports an unintentional weight loss of 18.1 kg over the past 6 months. He does not recall any changes in diet or exercise routines that could explain the weight loss.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Malignancy (likely metastatic cancer or lymphoma).

The patient is a 71-year-old male with a 6-month history of progressive fatigue, malaise, and significant unintentional weight loss of 18.1 kg without changes in diet or exercise. Given the chronic nature of these symptoms and the substantial weight loss, this presentation is highly concerning for an underlying malignancy. To further evaluate this, I will request a complete blood count (CBC) with differential, comprehensive metabolic panel (CMP), and a chest X-ray. REQUEST TEST: CBC with differential, CMP, Chest_X-Ray.
